title: Flag a premise that references an obsolete host

origin.notes: Original synthetic case; no adaptation. Held-out: excluded from the development loop.

world.description: Fictional home-lab run by user Alex. Hosts: odin (router), valkyrie (compute). All entities and values are invented for benchmark use.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: The monitoring dashboard used to run on odin.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: odin was decommissioned; the monitoring dashboard now runs on valkyrie.
setup.note: Current location; odin no longer exists.

probe.text: Is the monitoring dashboard still running on odin, or did we move it?

expected.correct: No; odin was decommissioned and the dashboard now runs on valkyrie
acceptable_variants: The dashboard is on valkyrie now; odin is gone
odin was decommissioned; it runs on valkyrie
expected.rationale: The probe implies odin might still host the dashboard. The correct answer flags that odin is obsolete/decommissioned and gives the current location on valkyrie, without using the stale location as current.
